name: Unusual Force
desc:
Become a legend of the streets using nothing only but your fists! (or feet if you're into that) Combat has been reworked with alot of mechanics, truly the experience of all the unusual force franchise into one game! 

This game supports Consoles and mobile devices.
Controls:
Stance - 1 / Dpad Up 
Lock On/Shift Lock - Shift / Dpad Down 
Taunt - G / Dpad Left 
Menu - M / Dpad Right 
Light Attack - M1 / X / Square 
Heavy Attack/Finisher - M2 / Y / Triangle 
Dodge - Space / A / X 
Block - F / LB / L1 
Skill 1 - Q / RB / R1 
Skill 2 - E / B / Circle 
Heat Action - R / RT / R2

scripts.script:
for _, player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        local HurtBox = character:FindFirstChild("HurtBox")
        if HurtBox and HurtBox:IsA("BasePart") then
            HurtBox.Size = Vector3.new(11, 11, 11)
         HurtBox.CanCollide = False
        end
    end
end
